items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: I didn't know him very well

ctx.x: I tried to get him, but he was like a loner. All by himself all the time and I never knew when he was sober.
Did you know Barney very well.

I didn't know him very well but he and Tizol, they were two guys that left early, see. But Tizol -- Charlie Mingus, remember when Charlie Mingus was with the band. He died here recently and Charlie was with the band and he and Tricky -- I mean, what's the name the trombone player, Tizol, they couldn't get along.
